pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark brown regions with sharp pixel gradients at edges. Geometric complexity is moderate, with spatial area of individual patches decreasing significantly toward the ventral and posterior regions of the flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological mesh. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radiate and quadri-radiate. Pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank with slight widening at nodal points.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette visible against the background along the upper neck and shoulder transition.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an avian organism (likely an oxpecker) perched on the dorsal ridge at the junction of the upper neck and shoulder.
